subject.title: fix(matrix): fallback to copy+unlink on EXDEV in legacy credentials migration

question: Is simulated log text enough for this Matrix persisted-credential migration, or must the contributor provide real cross-device startup evidence before merge?
rationale: The code change is plausible and focused, but the posted proof is not emitted by the implementation and the current path layout makes the claimed cross-device scenario unproven without a real setup.

options.title: Require real cross-device proof
options.body: Keep this PR open until the contributor posts redacted terminal output, logs, or an artifact from a Matrix startup where the migration actually hits the `EXDEV` fallback.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the mocked regression test and source inspection as enough for this low-blast-radius credential migration fix.

options.title: Pause without merging
options.body: Leave the branch idle if maintainers are not willing to accept persisted credential migration changes without contributor-run proof.

recommendation.title: Require real cross-device proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open until the contributor posts redacted terminal output, logs, or an artifact from a Matrix startup where the migration actually hits the `EXDEV` fallback.
